inspectedText:
In May, 1945, he went on a business trip to Mitsubishi Hiroshima Shipyard. He experienced the atomic bombing on August 6. Three days after that, he experienced the atomic bombing again in Nagasaki.
The train arrived at the terminal in Nagasaki in the late morning of August 8.
Then we talked about Hiroshima. Mr. Nomura was saying to me that he couldn’t believe just one bomb had destroyed the entire city . As he was saying that, there was that flash.
